what: Meta owns Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp and Messenger; more than 3 billion people use at least one of them every day. Reality Labs works on smart glasses and virtual reality.
customers: The apps are free; the real customers are millions of advertisers, from local shops to the biggest global brands.
money: targeted ads in Facebook and Instagram feeds, Stories and Reels
Quest headsets and Ray-Ban smart glasses
moat: Huge network effects, behavioral data from billions of users for ad targeting, and advanced AI for content recommendations.
risks: Very heavy AI spending and Reality Labs losses
Privacy and antitrust rules, especially in Europe
Total dependence on advertising, which falls in recessions
opportunities: Revenue grew about 22% last year with a 41% operating margin
Advertising revenue per user keeps rising as its AI ranking improves targeting
It reaches more than three billion people daily across its apps
watch: Advertising revenue growth and capital spending on AI infrastructure.
